Thanks for the update and fixing the issue! Plenty of other companies would
just rush it out the door and lose future business. Very smart!

Thanks

Adam

Hi Adam,

Thanks for that, it means a lot. Nobody likes the wait, but shipping a board we weren't sure about would have been worse for you and for us.

Where things stand: all 300 units are built and go out together, and Magic Miner expects them to leave the factory on November 12. Your tracking comes to this email the moment your miner ships. You can also follow the shipment on its way to us at https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

I was very happy to help. If you've been pleased with our service, a short review on Trustpilot would really help us: https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com

You're also welcome in our Discord for product news and setup help: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
